# SOIA

SOIA is a local-first agent platform built by soia-team.

- **SoiaDeck**: Desktop AI platform (local daemon, AI Workbench for Claude Code, Codex and 19 coding agents, local LLM and AI network). Currently private, coming open source.
- **Open Skills**: 47 public skills across 4 domains (PKM Vault 27, Dev 9, Office 7, Meta 4) for Claude Code, Codex and WorkBuddy. MIT licensed.
- **SoiaCode**: Lightweight Rust coding agent (`si`), currently in design (milestone M1), not open source yet.
- **SOIA Runtime**: Open-source Agent OS under github.com/soia-team/soia.
